in_marathi.name: Shaurya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King, Ruler, Lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaurya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shaurya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaurya' meaning 'King, Ruler, Lord'. In Hindu mythology, Shaurya is the name of a demon king from the Mahabharata epic. It is also a popular given name for boys in India.
